name: spicedice
description: SpiceDice: A real-time synchronized dice rolling for long-distance gaming. Crypto-fair rolls, shareable Pits, SSE sync.

scripts.build:engine: if command -v dune >/dev/null 2>&1; then cd ocaml && dune build; else echo 'build:engine: dune not found. One-time setup: opam switch create spicedice 5.2.1 && opam install dune js_of_ocaml js_of_ocaml-ppx, then eval $(opam env --switch=spicedice). Without the artifact, node server.js runs the behavior-identical pure-JS engine.' >&2; exit 1; fi
